channel.title: Music Business Worldwide (MBW) - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Music Business Worldwide (MBW) (musicbusinessworldwide.com)

item.title: Virgin Music Group completes Downtown acquisition; Pieter van Rijn named COO as Downtown founder Justin Kalifowitz steps away
item.description: Pieter van Rijn appointed Chief Operating Officer of VMG Source

item.title: From UMG’s deal with superfan platform EVEN to Live Nation’s $25B in 2025… it’s MBW’s weekly round-up
item.description: The biggest headlines from the past few days... Source

item.title: Apple revives the Apple Music Connect name — this time as a B2B promo platform for labels and distributors
item.description: The relaunched Apple Music Connect gives label and distributor teams a single dashboard to manage the parts of a release cycle. Source

item.title: AI sample generator Just 4 Noise raises $1M from BADideas.fund, Sound Hub Denmark and more
item.description: Just 4 Noise lets producers describe the sound they want and get “individual, unique, royalty-free sounds” that they can drop directly into their DAW. Source

item.title: Suno hires ex-Merlin CEO Jeremy Sirota as Chief Commercial Officer
item.description: Sirota will report directly to CEO Mikey Shulman. Source

item.title: Greg Prata promoted to Chief Financial Officer at Sony Music Publishing, as Tom Kelly retires after 35-year career
item.description: Prata will remain based in New York and report to SMP Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Jon Platt. Source

item.title: Atlantic Music Group strikes joint venture with indie label Today Is Vintage
item.description: Indie label was founded by Swedish music executive, artist, and entrepreneur, Rebin Shah Source

item.title: AI-driven kids media firm Animaj strikes global deal with The Orchard’s Magic Star and Sony Music Publishing
item.description: Deal sees The Orchard’s kids division handle recordings distribution while Sony Music Publishing administers publishing rights across Animaj’s catalogue. Source

item.title: Salt-N-Pepa file notice of appeal over UMG lawsuit dismissal, with ‘Blurred Lines’ lawyer as counsel
item.description: Lawsuit against UMG over the copyrights to their master recordings was dismissed in January Source

item.title: Live Nation files to pause antitrust case for appeal, days after pulling public post calling for DOJ to ‘move on’ and settle
item.description: Live Nation Entertainment asks judge to pause the DOJ antitrust case while two legal questions are reviewed by an appeals court. Source
